notes: v10.4 BUILD REFRESH (2026-11-14, b4747 — the seventeenth cut — no word lost where there is sound; the highlight ready at landing; your first word stays; for is not 4; one sound is one word; Google Sheets, notarized): (1) The first word of a dictation is no longer lost. The engine had heard the "I" of "I ran the terminal command", but the silent-span rule deleted it: at the start of speech the decoder stamps a word slightly ahead of its sound, and the rule read that stamp as silence. The rule now recognises a stamp that runs ahead of the sound (the next word follows without a gap and its own stamp also starts in silence) and never deletes such a word. (2) "One try" stays English. "Will the local one try to overwrite" came out as "the local TRY 1 to overwrite" because the currency rule read "one try" as one Turkish lira.
